title: Account Executive at Jobgether

pros: Enterprise cloud and AI platform market is adjacent to the profile

description_review: Building architecture project role in Basel producing technical drawings and documentation in ArchiCAD for Swiss construction projects. Requires about 3 years of Swiss project experience and native German; salary not disclosed.
pros: Structured documentation and coordination work is transferable in principle
cons: Physical building architecture, not software architecture
Requires ArchiCAD and Swiss construction regulation expertise

pros: Data architecture and enterprise-scale transformation experience is relevant
Regulated financial-services context is adjacent to banking

Requires German and Swiss regulatory knowledge
